scripts.build:frontend: cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join(__dirname,'..','frontend','dist');const dest=p.join(__dirname,'public');if(fs.existsSync(src)){if(fs.existsSync(dest))fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});console.log('Frontend build copied to public/');}"
